doc: Order arithmetic: the total of one order line, and of an order.

doc.prose: The total of an order: the sum of its lines' totals, each line a (quantity, unit price) pair. An empty order totals 0.0.

operations.what: the running sum of the line totals

covers.subject: the sum of line_total(q, p) over the lines

doc.prose: The total of one order line: its quantity times its unit price.
